name: Arvis
summary: Arvis features a honed Dover White marble top in a soft matte finish, giving the surface a calm, refined presence with subtle natural movement. The body is fully wrapped in Techno Walnut veneer, adding depth and a rich contemporary warmth. Inside, melamine panels keep the interior clean and well finished. The base in vintage brass introduces a warm, understated glow that completes the piece with a polished, modern sophistication. Top with honed Dover white marble(matte),the body all cover with Techno Walnut Veneer, inner panels with melamine. the base paint vintage brass. 200x42x80
